prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: transparent eight-pose game-character source sheet for review
Primary request: Create one cohesive rounded full-body pixel-art sheet for the ordinary clinic patient in everyday civilian clothes in Image2. Image1 controls only GS026 pixel-art style, proportional scale and eight-pose layout. Image2 controls every identity/outfit detail: a 43-year-old adult woman with tan skin, a straight black chin-length bob with silver temples and a heavy fringe, violet cat-eye glasses, and a petite build. They wear a crimson full-sleeved long cardigan over an ochre knit top, teal trousers and black loafers. All sleeves are full length to the wrists. No badge, lanyard, scrubs or white coat. Preserve every detail across all eight views.
Composition/framing: exactly two rows and four isolated full-body figures. Top left-to-right: standing SOUTH/front, EAST/true profile facing screen-right, WEST/true profile facing screen-left, NORTH/rear. Bottom same order: seated SOUTH/EAST/WEST/NORTH. Broad transparent gutters and generous row gap; every head and shoe fully visible and well away from canvas edges. Seated figures sit on invisible chairs, knees bent around90degrees, hands naturally on thighs, feet flat; no chair visible. Same head/body scale and proportions in standing and seated views. All eight figures, INCLUDING the bottom-right seated NORTH/rear figure, have full-length sleeves to the wrists. In that rear seated view BOTH elbows and forearms must be fully covered in sleeve fabric, with only hands showing skin. Sleeves remain full-length to wrists; outfit layers and garment hems rest naturally while seated.
Style/medium: soft rounded high-quality pixel art matching Image1, compact friendly proportions, crisp dark pixel-stepped outlines and softly textured shading.
Constraints: genuine transparent RGBA background; no hat, equipment, held props, chair, furniture, floor, shadow, glow, scenery, logo, text, readable badge, watermark, labels, grid, duplicate/missing/cropped pose.
